title: RISE Live: collection imagery (astronomy and landscapes) in the room
acceptance: The owner decides the design in docs/plans/LIVE-IMAGERY.md. Decided 2026-10-26: Option A (a collection is an engine; RISE chooses the work), landscapes' rights frozen at harvest with a monthly re-verification, 'Earth and sky' its own later set, and every collection image hung in the safe rectangle in both rooms.
First slice (LIVE-039): @scene <id> astronomy is read, admitted and lowered to { kind: 'sourced', collections: ['sci-astronomy'] }; a parameter on it is refused.

In the venue a reading with that scene shows an astronomy work hung in the safe rectangle of the full frame, in the dark room and the light room, never full-bleed and never in the inner eye or the shell; the previous visual holds until the image decodes, and a failed image never leaves a black or broken frame.
The chip shows the title before the credit and licence; at 1440x900 and 390x844 its box meets neither the words' zone, the ask bar, the docked face nor the sign-in link.
About this reading lists each picture shown with title, full credit, licence and source link.

The catalog words answer 'astronomy' at once with no model call; the first-load budget and the security policy are unchanged; Composer's guide does not offer the collection until the card can show it.

Later steps, each its own task: landscapes in Live (harvest frozen at harvest, monthly re-verification); the card's RISE image route; the 'Earth and sky' set after the owner's review by eye; collection parameters designed with the other natural-language visual parameters.
Human gate: the owner watches a real model's reading that uses the collection on the deployed /live, in the dark room and the light room.

evidence.note: Design only, branch live-imagery-design. Agent measurements, not human observations: the astronomy catalog holds 216 works (ESA/Hubble 98, NASA 64, ESO 54), landscapes 216 pins (Rijksmuseum 178, Cleveland 38); sampled ESA/ESO screen images are 1280 px wide and 138-251 KB, NASA's catalog files 640 px; the MCP card admits images from RISE's origin only; Cleveland's keyless API totals 458 CC0 landscape paintings and 145 CC0 landscape photographs. Nothing built.

Draft PR, branch live-imagery-design: the design. The owner's answers of 2026-10-26, relayed by the coordinating agent, are recorded in its 'Owner decisions' section; questions 5 to 10 are decided by default from the design's recommendations and may be revisited. Not merged.

activity.summary: Design written on branch live-imagery-design for the owner's decision: what exists, three options and a recommendation, the landscapes curation plan, the first slice and the owner's questions
Owner decisions of 2026-10-26 recorded in the design; first slice (LIVE-039) under way
